reviews.text: My animals have all been treated by Dr. Longy for the past six years, some until their very last day. He is truly passionate about animals, and it shows from the first meeting. He is patient, kind, and gives excellent advice without exaggerating or trying to add unnecessary costs. I recommend him 100%.
You can bring your little companions in for treatment with complete confidence. I highly recommend it!

A fantastic first experience! Mr. Longy took excellent care of our two naturally timid cats and made them feel completely at ease. He takes his time, is very gentle, and explains everything he's doing while he's grooming your furry friends.
We'll definitely be back!
Dr. Longy has been treating our cat for 15 years. He has been able to adapt to our cat's personality and always gives us excellent advice. Both compassionate and professional, I highly recommend him!

This is the second time this person has verbally abused me. Today, it was over a simple question about flea treatment, and he got angry and told me that without a prescription, he couldn't possibly give me anything. I didn't understand why, because I've been treating my cats for parasites for 20 years without an expensive consultation beforehand. When I didn't understand, he became condescending and repeatedly said, "Apparently you know my job better than I do," even though I never said anything of the sort. I just wanted to protect my cat, without being attacked or treated condescendingly. I could tell he was trying to make me feel guilty because I don't pay for consultations.

So there you have it, sir. I don't know who you think you are, but calm down. Your years of veterinary studies don't give you the right to disrespect people.

An absolutely lovely veterinarian, attentive, empathetic, and caring towards both animals and their owners.

I highly recommend them.

Mr. Longy saved our cat from a massive abscess. It was a major operation. He did a very good job. He's very competent and attentive. All our animals have been to him and we've always been satisfied. I highly recommend this veterinarian.

Very disappointed with this vet!

I took my cat in because he had all the symptoms of feline herpesvirus (cough, runny eyes, runny nose), but this vet declared he was fine and that it was normal!

After consulting another vet, feline herpesvirus was correctly diagnosed and treatment was prescribed.

Unfortunately, because of you, I now have two cats with feline herpesvirus who are suffering every day.

Dear pet owners: take care of your furry friends and always get a second opinion!!
Excellent vet, very attentive
This veterinarian is very pleasant and explains the work done perfectly, based on the symptoms and his experience. Highly recommended.

By nature, I'm an altruistic person, and I trusted this veterinarian, thinking my pet was in good hands.

My pet had undergone tests, and the initial diagnosis was that everything was more or less fine. However, a trusted friend who is a rural veterinarian, after reviewing the test results, determined that his kidney condition was actually quite concerning and that treatment should have been implemented. The emergency veterinary clinic confirmed this.

Despite this, this veterinarian offered no follow-up care or treatment, using the excuse that my pet was old. As a result, he did nothing to alleviate his suffering or prolong his life in better conditions. My companion died a few months later, without having had the slightest chance.

I find this highly questionable from an ethical standpoint: a veterinarian is supposed to do everything possible to support the animal and offer available treatment options, regardless of its age. In this case, I felt he simply let my pet die without trying anything. Absolutely nothing. I hope his conscience will one day remind him of the moral responsibility this profession entails.

Therefore, I do not recommend this practice. If you truly love your pet, you will undoubtedly find a much better option in Croix-Rousse.
Dr. Longy is incredibly kind and gentle with animals. Thank you for practicing your profession with such humanity and passion; I highly recommend this excellent veterinarian.

I am so glad to know that people like Dr. Longy still exist.
